sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser) and Internal Quality Checks row 26
evidence: All five dimension prompts open with 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1; scored/visual/prompt.md:1-2 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), and every judge.toml wires a playwright stdio MCP server (playwright-mcp --headless --isolated, chromium) with prompt_template='prompt.md'; functional also wires the verifier restart server. Prompts restrict evidence to the browser: render 'Use only rendered browser behavior' (:2), constraints 'browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only' (:2), polish 'Judge the rendered product and interactions, not code style' (:4), visual 'Score each criterion independently from rendered evidence' (:40), functional evidence discipline 'passes only on evidence you gathered in this session' (:23-28), 'use rendered controls' and 'Never use curl or shell commands' (:41-47). First-paint is explicitly rejected: scored prompts' global gate says 'a first-paint imitation does not pass' and rejects static mock/shell/seeded-looking facade (functional:11-19, polish:10-18, visual:18-26); render gate rejects 'static shell without meaningful data' (:10-11); constraints requires positive controls (:10-12) and its criterion posts JUDGE-G1, reloads and cross-checks from a second context (constraints/judge.toml criterion). Criteria are action-based (sign in, post, reply, replay recorded requests, reload, restart_app, resize), so they cannot be satisfied from source, memory or a first paint; app_context.md gives localhost URL and browser-context instructions. Risk=true: raw-evidence-index.json states a full configured grading run is absent and the scripted golden is not a judge run, so no judge trace confirms the judge actually drove the browser; also the claude-code judge shares the container with /app source (template-identical test.sh/Dockerfile), so browser-only grading relies on prompt instructions, which are present. Adversarial: a static mock with seeded first paint fails the constraints gate (post+reload+second-context) and the scored global gates; a conforming app with different routes/labels is protected by 'Match controls by intent and label', 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable'.
